Structural fix: the orchestrator fixes the canonical AT/TC registry BEFORE dispatch, and the Phase-1 iteration runs as a SINGLE agent folding both reviews rather than two in parallel.

Inert pre-change because wrows absorbed budget; post-change 44 blank rows and '+N not shown' on all 18 renders as specified, 0 and 0 corrected.

Measured alternative if ever wanted: (2*room)//3 -> bench 58-64%, ~2 blank rows per render.
